findings.claim: FY2026 Pharmaceutical and Specialty Solutions 營收 +15% 至 $234.8B，來自既有與新客戶的品牌藥與特殊藥銷售成長；segment profit +23% 至 $2.8B
findings.excerpt: Pharma segment revenue for fiscal 2026 increased 15 percent to $234.8 billion from the prior year, primarily due to branded and specialty pharmaceutical sales growth from existing and new customers

findings.claim: FY2026 GMPD 營收約持平（$12.7B，+1%）：自有品牌成長被配送量下滑與 IEEPA 關稅退款返還客戶抵銷；segment profit +91% 至 $258M
findings.source: Cardinal Health FY2026 Form 10-K（經搜尋摘要）

findings.claim: FY2027 指引：Pharma 營收 +3~5%、segment profit +8~11%；GMPD 營收 +2~4%、segment profit $200~220M；non-GAAP EPS $12.40~12.60
findings.source: Cardinal Health Q4 FY26 Earnings Press Release

findings.claim: FY2026 Q4 GLP-1 成長與 IRA WAC 調整各約 500bps 的反向營收影響；specialty 成長 FY2026 超過 25%
findings.source: MarketBeat Cardinal Health Q4 earnings call highlights（經搜尋摘要）

findings.claim: 管理層預期 FY2027 學名藥量回歸常態；品牌轉學名藥（LOE）對營收是下拉、對利潤為正；公司處於 McKesson、Cencora 三強高度集中且競爭激烈的配送業
findings.source: MarketBeat Q3 FY26 call highlights／10-K（經搜尋摘要）
